text:
nia: Heads up  contractors on the Partner Interviewer roster can't see the scorecard during interviews. They get a blank panel that says 'no rubric assigned'.

nia: This started after the SSO->SCIM sync last night. I noticed it when pairing a contractor in a mock panel.

harper: yikes. Which partner org? We have 9 active external interviewers from VendorX today.

contractor-admin: Confirmed. I just got a DM from one of VendorX interviewers: 'I only see candidate info, no rubric or scoring widget'. They attached a screenshot.

jonas: tagging infra. I see the audit log: SCIM synced group membership at 2026-08-14T02:05:10Z and set external users to role=partner_viewer. Our feature gate for 'scorecard_view' is only enabled for internal_staff and hiring_admins. That explains it.

ats-bot: webhook: scim.sync completed job=scim-2026-08-14-02:05. UsersUpdated=47.

harper: impact: 9 live interviews with VendorX panels, 3 debriefs already submitted with 'no scores' placeholders. Risk: missing data and extra work to collect scores afterwards.

nia: can we flip a flag to allow partner_viewer to see the rubric read-only? They don't need vote power, just view + submit scores.

jonas: short-term mitigation: I can enable 'scorecard_read' for partner_viewer on the RBAC service. That will grant view in ~30s. But need org approval to change external roles.

contractor-admin: Please do. Interviewers are waiting in panels. They can't meaningfully assess without the rubric.

jonas: done: RBAC change applied. partner_viewer now has scorecard_read. Propagation logs show success.

people-ops-bot: automated: Applied RBAC change rbac-change-893 at 2026-08-14T02:12:05Z. ChangeAuthor=jonas.

harper: confirmed with contracting lead: VendorX interviewers can now see the rubric. Thanks.

nia: for the three debriefs already submitted with blanks, can we surface them in an admin queue so hiring teams can prompt re-submission?

jonas: i'll add a filter in the debrief admin UI to show submissions with missing scores and tag them 'external_missing_rubric'. Will push a small migration to mark affected rows.

people-ops-bot: ticket created: RECRUIT-2411 'external users missing rubric after SCIM role mapping' assigned=jonas,harper.

harper: follow-ups: 1) infra to update SCIM->RBAC mapping so external roles get scorecard_read by default 2) people-ops to add a note to vendor onboarding checklist to verify rubric access 3) eng to add an E2E smoke that logs in as a partner_viewer and asserts rubric visibility.

contractor-admin: can we also add a temporary calendar attachment (canonical rubric PDF) for VendorX panels today in case any other downstream delay happens? I can attach now.

nia: yes please attach and post in the panel description: 'If you cannot see the rubric in-app, use this PDF and message ops'.

jonas: created a PR to update SCIM mapping and added the e2e smoke test. Will merge after a quick review.

harper: great work. Let's also add a runbook step: when SCIM sync occurs, verify RBAC role coverage for external roles within 5 minutes. Saves a lot of scramble.

nia: agreed. closing this thread after the debrief queue is populated and the PR is merged. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
